global: This shio ramen boasts a clear, light broth with delicate noodles, topped with menma, naruto fish cake, and a citrus slice. Served in a patterned bowl, it rests on a wooden table under soft, natural light, with chopsticks poised for eating.

regions.background: Dark wooden table with visible grain patterns and parallel planks, showing natural texture and subtle color variations.
regions.bowl: White ceramic bowl with red geometric patterned rim, smooth glossy surface, circular shape, slightly raised edge.
regions.soup: Clear, golden broth with thin noodles, garnished with green onions, orange slice, and pink-edged fish cake, all floating in the liquid.
regions.chopsticks: Light beige chopsticks, smooth and slightly glossy, lie parallel with rounded ends and subtle wood grain texture.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear pale yellow, slightly translucent, with curled, layered shapes and visible fibrous texture.
regions.naruto: Naruto fish cake: pink-rimmed, pale white, rectangular slice with smooth, slightly glossy surface and faint speckles.
